integration_decision.name: VALID_NO_NEWLINE_ARCHIVE_E2E_FAIL_CLOSED_OR_COMMIT
integration_decision.finding: C's storage-level valid-no-terminal-newline append risk crosses the runner boundary. Pinned _load_observations_unlocked accepts a complete final JSONL row without newline; append_observations opens in append mode and writes the next row with no separator. In run_once, append precedes load and all three atomic handoff writes. A distinct PIT-visible rowB may therefore be appended into malformed {rowA}{rowB}\n; subsequent load raises ValueError after archive mutation, leaving previously published handoffs intact but the archive unusable. Source-derived risk, not a reproduced incident.
integration_decision.decision: Use ONE shared A+C acceptance target, not duplicate Gemini tasks. Accept either (i) successful durable separation and complete end-to-end publication, or (ii) explicit fail-closed rejection BEFORE any archive/handoff mutation. Reject malformed mutated archive plus stale handoffs even if the exception is caught by the test. Preserve independent two-writer, stale-rollback, orphan and role-identity gates.
integration_decision.runnable_no_network_contract: At exact SHA in isolated tmp_path: create rowA as a complete valid FlowObservation JSONL without terminal newline; assert load_observations=1. Run baseline run_once(network=False,local_dir=tmp_path,as_of_ms=T) and snapshot archive bytes and all three handoff bytes/hashes. Build distinct rowB (different source_record_id/revision_key; effective/available/observed<=T; scoring role), write immutable external fixture, assert JsonlFlowAdapter.collect() returns exactly rowB. Call run_once(network=False,external_jsonl=(fixture,),local_dir=tmp_path,as_of_ms=T). Success branch: appended=1, archive two parseable separate lines, loaded/scoring=2, all three handoffs parse and match T and rowB scoring identity; replay same fixture appended=0 and no duplicate. Rejection branch: require explicit error and byte-identical archive plus all three prior handoffs, and load_observations still returns rowA. Any partially mutated invalid JSONL, missing rowB on success, or mixed handoff generation is RED. No network, sleeps, skips, xfail or production edits.
integration_decision.proof_boundary: Only exact source and existing positive-control test inspected. Contract NOT RUN. Current source predicts failure; do not claim confirmed production defect.
